purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S4C-2p0, S4C-6p3, S4C-13p2. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py; entries resolved from the sealed record analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/profile/s4c_record_A52.json (register A52, PA-18). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES (this plan declares no gates); it stops automatically only at the launch budget / C10 cap. Stop rules are applied manually from the RUN_INDEX state columns (run_id, label, exit_code, converged) and the sealed wrapper records; results/campaigns/<plan>.json carries the runner fit metrics and is not opened before the wrapper record exists (A52 (f)).
stop_rules: Register A52 (b), CAMPAIGN_DESIGN l.325 / l.327: S4c native confirmation of the best S4a candidate S4A-04 (frozen surrogate on the complete inventory of 15: ABORT S4b) at the profiled Q_f 1.61169e12 cm^-2 and mu_band_fitted[t] (mu_inf 248.36 cm2/Vs, ell 50 nm at the range bound; FITTED); one invocation, S4C-2p0 (1600 s), S4C-6p3 (2000 s), S4C-13p2 (3100 s).

Read-out: s4c_confirm_wrapper.py confirm <S4C-2p0 dir> <S4C-6p3 dir> <S4C-13p2 dir> --committed <record sha256>: PASS iff every film agrees with the transformed S4A-04 run within 0.01 dec on every J-window point (unchanged profile_shared.check); FAIL -> the native result is reported and the profiling audited before S5; an ineligible endpoint -> UNKNOWN, never PASS.

Not state-only (A52 (f)): the outputs are read ONLY through analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/s4c_confirm_wrapper.py (sealed records profile/s4c_confirm_A52.json and profile/s4d_readout_A52.json); the console goes to a gitignored log and only its state lines (id, run id, status, error) are read; no curve, metric or deckbuild.out line is read by hand before the wrapper record exists.

Every launch counts; a failed or timed-out launch is recorded invalid and kept, never deleted; no repeat, no --retry, no repair without a logged decision (the six PA-19 v3 repairs stay reserved); the affected verdict is UNKNOWN (PA-18 (a)).
Variable reference: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/profile/s4c_record_A52.json (sealed; its sha256 committed before the first launch and passed to the wrapper as --committed).
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and C10 cap and refuses runnable=false plans; no gates
register_amendment: A52 (2026-10-15; PA-18 S4c confirmation wrapper, S4c / S4d execution entries, S4d runner-up rule, H gate; no Codex review, D-63): invoke only after A52 and its decision row are logged and the variable-reference record sha256 is committed, with the go for THIS launch (the hook asks the user), immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_h.py has exited 0 naming this plan
launch_command: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml"; <project venv python> scripts/run_campaign.py config/campaign_C10_S4c.json *> results/campaign_C10_S4c_console_inv<k>.log   (PowerShell, package root, immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_h.py exited 0 naming this plan; no --retry; IWO_ATLAS_VIEWERS unset; console redirected to a gitignored log that is read for state lines only)
